q2024p_j2_yr.rule_y2: FLASH_S5_YIELD_WINDOW: unset or 0 is today's one append per yield (no window record, no window call); 1: a yield is a window. After the current append's handback was served (FULL window, or kept split by O3), native_auto_arm asks engine_driver.append_yield_window_offer for the next waiting eligible append (append_yield_candidate: FCFS, max_new, slot, decode-cover and KV-block gates per candidate, the per-bulk lookup memo and refusals) before the re-entry; at the re-entry's arm (FULL enter_split or the O3 census) append_yield_window_begin starts it (phase append) instead of the owner's resume. The owner re-enters as today when none waits, at YIELD_WINDOW_MAX_APPENDS=4 appends (the first included), after an unserved handback (abort, skip, expiry) or when the staged append left before the arm. PER_BULK counts windows. A geometry-tail append is served only after its r rows ran on FULL (O3 never keeps a tail split); counted as tail_full_handbacks. Any other value refuses at controller construction
